title: Review tracked changes with Parachute
summary: Parachute now reads the tracked changes in a document, explains what each one does, and accepts or rejects them on your call.
body_markdown:
When a marked-up draft comes back from the other side, the first job is working out what changed. Parachute now does that with you.


## Understand every change


- Ask what the other side changed and Parachute reads every tracked change in the document.
- It explains what each change does, so you can see what matters quickly.
- Tell it which changes to accept or reject, and it applies them for you.


## Your name on the redline


Workspace admins can choose whose name appears on the tracked changes Parachute makes: the person who asked for the edit, or your firm. A redline you send out reads as your work.
